source.title: Weaviate Vector Store: Clear Data keeps only the last insert batch

labels.name: status:in-linear
labels.description: Issue or PR is now in Linear

source.body:
### Bug Description

"Clear Data" in the Weaviate Vector Store insert keeps only the last batch of documents.

From node version 1.1, the insert writes the documents in batches ("Embedding Batch Size", default 200). The node deletes the collection (or the tenant) before each batch, not one time before the insert. So an insert of more documents than the batch size loses data, and the node shows no error.

### To Reproduce

1. Add a Weaviate Vector Store node (version 1.1 or later). Select the "Insert Documents" operation.
2. Turn on "Clear Data". Set "Embedding Batch Size" to 1.
3. Insert 3 documents.
4. Count the objects in the collection. It has 1 object.

### Expected behavior

The node clears the collection one time, before the first batch. After the insert, the collection has all 3 documents.

### Debug Info

Found in a code review of `VectorStoreWeaviate.node.ts`. Reproduced on `master` with a local Weaviate 1.39.16 server. Fix: #43518.

### Operating System

macOS 26.6.2

### n8n Version

2.48.0 (master)

### Node.js Version

24.21.0

### Database

SQLite (default)

### Execution mode

main (default)

### Hosting

self hosted
